_about: Other projects whose fixes matter to Soncle. Watch only: nothing is copied. tools/watch-upstreams.mjs lists their new releases and relevant commits each week in a GitHub issue. 'seen' is updated by the tool.

sources.why: YouTube Music desktop app (Electron; formerly th-ch/youtube-music). Same platform as Soncle: sign-in, playback, plugins such as crossfade, equalizer, lyrics, skip silences.
The library Soncle uses for every YouTube request. Most 'YouTube changed something' fixes land here first (Dependabot also opens the version bump).
Early warning: yt-dlp usually reacts within hours when YouTube changes stream clients, client versions or PO token rules.
Releases and fix commits of the upstream Android app (file-level porting is handled by tools/upstream-sync.mjs).
